rows.grounds: object of the imperative; denotes the immortal essence
compound qualifying the nectar; kāmakalā + ātmaka

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the nectar identified as the Kaula reality?
premises: The nectar is identified as the true nature of Kaula.
This Kaula reality possesses a specific essential constitution.
Its essence is constituted by Kāmakalā.
items.inference: The nectar of the Kaula reality is essentially constituted by Kāmakalā.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal scope of kāmakalā in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true reality of Kaula, whose essence is Kāmakalā.
